### Phase Q8: graduate the Quality-only chroma QM allocation — B=4 above 1 bpp and X=3 at or below it

`proposed` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.quality-q8-chroma-allocation/1` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.encoder-optimization/1`

Extend the promoted Phase Q2 Quality-only chroma refinement to the two surfaces it left neutral, where the rate ladder was undershooting the byte target and leaving chroma bits unspent: the B channel above 1 bpp (scale 4, since Q2's B=5 there overshot the Butteraugli 3-norm bound) and the X channel at or below 1 bpp (scale 3). The policy stays confined to the exhaustive Quality preset, so Fast, Balanced, the seven-scene screen, and every fixed-quantizer stream remain byte-identical; rename ChromaHfPolicy::QualityLowRateB5 to QualityChroma, graduate effective_b_qm_scale across the 1 bpp boundary, add a mirroring effective_x_qm_scale, and make the CLI pin Manual for an explicit --x-qm-scale so a research override still wins. Promote only if the standing photo ladder and seven-scene screen pass the Contract B bounds against the frozen Phase Q7 binary with both decoders accepting every changed stream.
